item.g:title: Claude Code Coaching — Lecture + Workshop (3 Days)

Claude Code Coaching

Disciplined agentic engineering for EU teams — get your engineers from AI-curious to shipping real changes with Claude Code, through a governed plan → review → ship workflow. EU-sovereign throughout: your code and IP never leave the jurisdiction.

Why this product

AI literacy is now a legal requirement, not a nice-to-have. EU AI Act Article 4 obliges organisations to ensure their people can use AI systems competently. But literacy alone does not make a team productive — engineers need a discipline for working with an autonomous coding agent: how to scope it, govern it, review its output, and keep quality high. Claude Code Coaching delivers both: the literacy and the discipline, on your own codebase, without sending any IP to a US-hosted service.

  • The 12 rules of disciplined agentic engineering
  • Context engineering: CLAUDE.md project memory, skills, slash commands, MCP tools
  • The GREEN / YELLOW / RED trust boundary for autonomous actions
  • A live plan → implement → review → ship demonstration

Outcome: everyone shares the same model of how to work with Claude Code, and the organisation has EU AI Act Article 4 AI-literacy evidence.

2-Day Workshop — "Claude Code in Practice"

Hands-on, on your own repository:

  • Author CLAUDE.md project memory tailored to your codebase

  • Capstone: every participant ships a real change through the full gated flow

Outcome: the team is productive on day one after the workshop, the repo is restructured for agentic development, and quality governance is in place.

Option: Client Project Work

An optional embedded engagement: senior engineers apply Claude Code to a real backlog item end-to-end alongside your team — co-building skills and agents, setting up CI discipline gates, and transferring knowledge. Outcome-priced and scoped per engagement. EU-sovereign throughout.

The project track doesn't bill hours — it builds IPR capital your company owns: code, agents and services that stay with you and compound in value. Example projects:
